backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality with access control, Stripe integration, blob storage, product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding/homepage configuration, shop details, and description templates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a visual Stripe configuration status indicator in the StripeSetup component with green checkmark when configured.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the e-commerce application with branding, product management, and Stripe integration.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining colors for UI elements like background, foreground, primary, secondary, borders, and charts.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with 'Original Creations Hub' title, root div for React mounting, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment success/failure, terms, and privacy policy, wrapped in ThemeProvider with Toaster and dynamic branding hook.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and form submission using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Bulk product upload component with template selector for pre-populating descriptions, auto-copy toggle to sync fields across products, individual image handling with upload progress, and batch product creation functionality.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing description templates with name and content fields, using mutations to save changes and displaying toast notifications.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with create, edit, and delete functionality, including confirmation dialogs and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site information, legal links (Terms & Privacy Policy), contact email, copyright notice, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution link.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Form component for managing homepage configuration including hero motto, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header navigation (logo, basket with count badge, dashboard, login/logout), authentication handling via Internet Identity, and footer integration.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component displaying product image, name, shape, category, and price with an 'Add to Basket' button that triggers cart mutations and shows loading states.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog component that displays detailed product information including image, shape, category, description, and price, with buttons to add to basket or buy now.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing capabilities for name, description, shape, category, price, and images, plus inventory count adjustment controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that previously showed a profile setup modal after login; currently returns null.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form component for configuring shop details including name, address, contact information, opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Configuration form for setting up Stripe payment integration with secret key input and allowed countries selection, showing configuration status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on branding configuration fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating data including user profiles, products (with filters like most viewed, best selling, newest), cart operations, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, homepage config, and description templates.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that displays cart items or a single "Buy Now" product, calculates totals, and creates a Stripe checkout session to redirect users to payment.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates; displays statistics like product count and inventory value.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying featured, most viewed, best selling, and newest products with filtering by shape and category; includes hero section with configurable motto and promotional text.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart and buy-now session data, displays a confirmation message, and provides a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, payment processing, data security, user rights, cookies, children's privacy, and contact details in a card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls, removal functionality, price calculations, and checkout navigation using React Query hooks for cart management.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static terms and conditions page covering introduction, products/services, pricing/payment, shipping/delivery, returns/refunds, intellectual property, liability, and contact information in a card layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended typography, container queries, animations, custom fonts (Inter and Crimson Pro), and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking an artisan marketplace with bulk image upload, AI descriptions, Stripe integration, and known issues including image persistence failures and checkout redirect problems.
